notes: Current MDF behavior only redirects workflow artifact persistence into MDF work item storage.

exactPatches.search: If the user wants the intent to persist (a multi-session project, a handoff to another collaborator), offer to save it to `docs/intent/[topic].md`. Only save if they confirm.
exactPatches.replace: If the user wants the intent to persist (a multi-session project, a handoff to another collaborator), offer to save it to the current MDF work item as `.mdf/work/{work_id}/intent-NNN.md`. Only save if they confirm.

normalizedDifferences: Rendered from the pinned upstream source with upstream artifact persistence instructions replaced by the MDF artifact-storage policy. Non-storage drift in the previous full replacement is intentionally normalized back to upstream and documented in the overlay v2 migration report.
